headlines.article_text: Anthropic IPO live updates: ANT stock price and Nasdaq debut Skip Navigation Markets Business Investing Tech Politics & Policy Video Watchlist Investing Club PRO Livestream Menu watch now VIDEO 2:18 02:18 Anthropic's IPO could mint thousands of millionaires — and reshape San Francisco Tech Anthropic is set for its long-awaited Nasdaq debut on Thursday, after the artificial intelligence lab raised over $81 billion in a record IPO , surpassing SpaceX 's offering in June. The Claude creator sold 980 million shares at $83 a piece on Wednesday, lifting the size and price of its offering. Its fully diluted market cap sits at around $1.5 trillion. Tune in at 10:00 a.m. ET as Dario and Daniela Amodei join CNBC TV exclusively to talk about the debut. Watch in real time on CNBC+ or the CNBC Pro stream The 5-year-old company captivated the corporate world with its Claude AI models and products, which have fueled its meteoric rise this year. Anthropic said in its prospectus that it generated $33.24 billion in revenue for the nine months ended Sept. 30, up a staggering 1,200% from the same period last year. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei co-founded the company in 2021 after he and a small group of researchers defected from OpenAI , now its chief rival. Anthropic has faced sharp criticism over its positions on safety, regulation and national security, including by President Donald Trump and other senior government officials. The company will list on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol "ANT," and its debut will be a big test for the AI industry. Investors have been fretting over Jensen Huang's sudden ouster at Nvidia , voters' stinging rebuke of AI during the midterm elections and the feasibility of a multitrillion-dollar infrastructure buildout . "Our aim is to help humankind chart a safe course through this technological evolution, open new frontiers of discovery, and bring forth an age of miracles," Anthropic's co-founders wrote in the company's prospectus. "Everyone who owns our stock, whether an institution or an individual, becomes part of that effort." Read more CNBC news on Anthropic Anthropic IPO live updates: ANT stock price and Nasdaq debut Anthropic IPO raises over $81 billion in largest offering on record, topping SpaceX How to get Anthropic stock — without buying the IPO Small investor enthusiasm for Anthropic IPO to rival SpaceX debut Meet the seven co-founders of Anthropic Anthropic's Wall Street whisperer: CFO Krishna Rao CNBC's reporters are covering Anthropic's IPO live on air and online from our bureaus in San Francisco and Englewood Cliffs, New Jersey, and from the Nasdaq in New York City. 5 Min Ago Academics and industry experts circulate ‘The MisAnthropic Statement’ ahead of listing More than 90 academics and AI safety experts signed " The MisAnthropic Statement " ahead of the company's Nasdaq debut, blasting it for amassing power and rushing to build potentially dangerous technology. "Anthropic warns that recursively self-improving AI could concentrate power and escape human control, yet races to build it first," the statement says. "The company uses safety branding to court investors, employees, and the public — even as it has quietly weakened its safety pledges and lobbied for self-serving regulation. Anthropic is not a safe AI company, and we must reject its reckless attempt to amass power in the name of the greater good." A representative for Anthropic declined to comment about the statement. — Ashley Capoot 48 Min Ago Anthropic’s explosive revenue growth The Anthropic Claude logo on a smartphone and laptop arranged in San Francisco, California, Nov. 10, 2026. David Paul Morris | Bloomberg | Getty Images Anthropic's revenue has surged dramatically this year as more companies have adopted its AI models and products. The company said it generated roughly $33.24 billion in revenue for the nine months ended Sept. 30, up roughly 1,200% from the same period last year. Anthropic's losses also widened, however. It reported a $104 billion net loss during the period, compared to a net loss of $25.1 billion over the same stretch in 2025. The vast majority of its loss, about $94.3 billion, comes from a change in fair value of convertible notes, derivative liabilities and SAFEs, Anthropic said. The company said its run-rate revenue was roughly $81 billion as of the end of October, up roughly $10 billion from the previous month. — Ashley Capoot 48 Min Ago Anthropic’s seven co-founders have majority voting power Anthropic said in its prospectus that it believes its seven co-founders are "distinctly equipped to be stewards of our mission." The co-founders are the sole members of " Founder LLC ," a new entity that holds 50.1% of the voting power of the company's outstanding shares. The structure gives them "the ability to determine the outcome of all matters submitted to a vote of our stockholders generally for the foreseeable future," according to the filing. The co-founders' combined voting power from their holdings and their interest in Founder LLC is expected to be 61.3%, according to the filing.
